g.text: Tick the steps to apply. 'safe' steps only fix how values are stored and are ticked for you. Steps re-run from the raw file, so unticking undoes
ask Fill 177 missing in 'Age' with the mean
Turns 'Age' into a few ranges (like 0-10, 10-20) so you can compare groups, for example the share of a target in each age band.
